newsitem.title: USA: Allstate, Avon Mexico win Catalyst diversity awards.
newsitem.headline: Allstate, Avon Mexico win Catalyst diversity awards.

text.p: Allstate Insurance Co. and Avon Products Inc.'s Avon Mexico unit were awarded the Catalyst Award for women's advancement, the organisation said Tuesday.

Catalyst, a women's research and business advisory organisation, gave the 1997 awards to the companies "for vision-driven policies to advance women that have yielded measurable results," said Catalyst President Sheila Wellington.

Allstate "moves the concept of corporate diversity beyond training into measurement and accountability," Catalyst said. The insurance giant devised a means of maintaining and improving a diverse workplace through the use of questionnaires, feedback and diversity training.

Avon Mexico "takes accountability for women's advancement seriously," and participates in annual executive resource reviews to identify the highest potential executives for development and advancement, Catalyst said.
In Mexico, where women make up only 20 percent of the work force, Avon Mexico has a staff that is 54 percent female. It currently has one of the country's few women vice presidents.
The Catalyst awards will be presented in March.
